title: near-workspaces wraps the real compile error in a long, misleading dump
summary: `near_workspaces::compile_project` reports a failed build as `error running a build command with cargo near`, followed by a note that cargo-near may not be installed, even when cargo-near is installed and the real cause is a compiler error far below in the output.

symptoms.pattern: error running a build command with `cargo near

steps: Ignore the 'cargo-near is not installed' note unless `cargo near --version` itself fails.
Read the first `error[E....]` line in the dump (shown above as the real cause).
Reproduce faster with `cargo near check` in the contract directory.

evidence.observed: Reproduced 2026-11-13 (macOS 15 arm64, rustc 1.100.0, cargo-near 0.23.0, near-sdk 5.30.1, node 26.12.1): sandbox tests printed about 150 lines ending in a build failure; the real cause (E0428) was roughly 100 lines below the misleading note.
